items.title: New API version 2026-10-21 and 2.0 SDKs for Python and TypeScript
items.text: The Messages API has a new version, 2026-10-21. Tool-use content blocks now carry an explicit `status` field, and the legacy `completions` helper is removed. The 2.0 Python and TypeScript SDKs require the new API version and make `max_tokens` a required argument on every `messages` call. The previous API version stays available until the end of January. Apps that call the Messages API through an SDK should upgrade the SDK and pass the new version header.
